name: Berrey Dhone

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Berrey Dhone carries weight in Manx folk tradition as a legendary witch. She stands as the subject of several ballads from the Isle of Man. Many of these ballads draw her as an amazon able to step over whole mountain crests in one stride. Another strand of the same tales reads her name as Brown Berry and places her on or within North Barrule. There she looms as a giant, much like other forms of the Cailleach. Her heel print still shows in the mountain rock. Berrey Dhone lives longest in the verse that kept her strange power remembered across the island.

okr.objective: Record Berrey Dhone as a legendary Manx witch who fills several Isle of Man ballads and may stride across mountains.
key_results: Berrey Dhone is a legendary witch in Manx folk tradition.
She is the subject of several ballads from the Isle of Man.
One tradition shows her as an amazon that strides over mountains.
An other strand reads her as a giant tied to North Barrule and the Cailleach.
